packages.label: GTFparse
packages.summary: Parses GTF into data tables that reference-aware tools can use.
packages.boundary: Handles the file format; PyEnsembl adds indexed biological queries.

packages.label: PyEnsembl
packages.output: Genes, transcripts, exons, and sequence lookups
packages.summary: Provides local access to Ensembl annotations and sequences for a chosen reference.
packages.boundary: Keeps reference identity and transcript context underneath variant interpretation.

packages.label: Varcode
packages.summary: Predicts how variants affect genes, transcripts, and protein sequence.
packages.boundary: Proposes transcript and protein consequences; RNA evidence is handled by Isovar.

packages.label: Isovar
packages.input: Variant calls and aligned tumor RNA reads
packages.summary: Reconstructs and translates mutant RNA sequences around variants.
packages.boundary: Uses observed reads to establish sequence evidence rather than filling gaps from a reference.

packages.label: MHCgnomes
packages.input: MHC names across species and conventions
packages.summary: Parses MHC nomenclature so tools agree on which allele a name refers to.
packages.boundary: Identity parsing is shared infrastructure, separate from sequence curation or prediction.

packages.label: MHCseqs
packages.input: MHC sequence sources and allele identities
packages.summary: Downloads, curates, and extracts regions from MHC protein sequences.
packages.boundary: Provides sequence resources; it is not itself a peptide-binding predictor.

packages.label: MHCflurry
packages.input: Peptides, MHC alleles, and model bundles
packages.summary: Provides trained models for MHC class I binding, antigen processing, and presentation.
packages.boundary: Owns the models; MHCTools provides a common interface across prediction tools.

packages.label: MHCTools
packages.input: Peptides or proteins, alleles, and a predictor
packages.summary: Runs binding, presentation, immunogenicity, and processing predictors through shared interfaces.
packages.boundary: Standardizes access and results across predictors, including MHCflurry and external tools.

packages.label: Topiary
packages.input: Antigen sequences or variants and prediction settings
packages.summary: Combines peptide prediction with composable filtering and ranking.
packages.boundary: Supports multiple antigen sources; Vaxrank adds the personalized candidate-ranking workflow.

packages.label: Vaxrank
packages.input: Variants, RNA evidence, HLA type, or imported candidate evidence
packages.summary: Brings variant interpretation, peptide evidence, and prediction together for neoantigen ranking.
packages.boundary: Coordinates a candidate-ranking workflow using specialized libraries underneath it.

packages.label: DataCache
packages.summary: Handles downloading, verification, transformation, and caching of data used by other packages.
packages.boundary: Data acquisition and storage are shared mechanics, separate from the meaning of each dataset.

packages.label: Serializable
packages.boundary: Keeps serialization mechanics out of domain-specific classes.

packages.label: Sercol
packages.summary: Provides collection helpers used by variant and epitope collections.
packages.boundary: Shared collection behavior stays independent of the objects being analyzed.

packages.label: Osteosarc
packages.input: Public osteosarcoma dataset metadata and sequencing files
packages.output: Queryable data and selected read fixtures
packages.summary: Exposes a public osteosarcoma dataset and helps extract small read fixtures.
packages.boundary: Supplies provenance-rich research and test data; it is not a ranking algorithm.

packages.label: Oncoref
packages.input: Cancer, gene, cohort, and expression reference sources
packages.summary: Provides curated cancer reference data, expression references, and gene identity.
packages.boundary: Reference facts are reusable underneath downstream gene panels and analyses.

packages.label: PirlyGenes
packages.input: Gene identities, curated sets, and reference expression
packages.output: Gene panels, gene families, and expression resources
packages.summary: Provides curated cancer gene sets and reference expression resources.
packages.boundary: Owns purpose-specific gene selections, with shared reference mechanics delegated to Oncoref.
